{{Horus}}

Horus is the intercalary month of the [[Gaian calendar]]. It contains 7 days (one intercalary week) and occurs only in years with 53 ISO weeks.

== Overview ==
===Etymology===
''Horus'' is named for the Egyptian falcon deity associated with kingship and the sky. Japanese usage follows the loan {{ill|ホルス|ja}} (''Horusu'').  
===Gaiad themes===
**Intercalary month** that holds the **extra 7 days** (Days [[Horus 1]]–[[Horus 7]]) outside the regular 13×28 structure. Functions as a liminal bridge between years for epilogues, cleansings, and "reset" rites.  
===EVENTS===
(Intercalary observances vary by year; no fixed civil holidays are defined here.)
